description: Enrich a list of specific contacts with verified contact details and AI-powered insights. Each lead can be identified by LinkedIn URL or a combination of first name, last name, and company name/domain. Returns enriched data including verified emails, phone numbers, professional summary, top problems, strategic initiatives, and public appearances. Uses credits (from 1 per lead, more with contact details); precept_check_credits shows the balance. Runs asynchronously and returns an enrichment_id (jobId). Check progress with precept_get_job_status; jobs can take up to about 10 minutes, so checking every ~4 seconds for up to about 150 checks before treating a job as stalled gives the best experience, with a brief progress update to the user every minute or so.

generateMessage.description: Optional array specifying outreach channels to generate personalized messages for: 'email' (PIPE framework cold email: Problem, Impact, Proof, Engage under 70 words, < 6 words subject line) and/or 'linkedin' (SHIP framework conversational connection/DM: Signal, Hypothesis, Intro, Personalisation). Generates high-converting, tailored outreach copy using lead's profile, company problems, initiatives, and recent posts.

includeContactDetails.description: Whether to find and verify email and phone numbers (+1 credit for email per lead, +10 for phone per lead, or +11 for both per lead). If true, results include enrich_email and enrich_phone fields. Contact details add significant cost, so enable this when the user asks for emails or phone numbers.

interests.description: Optional array of up to 5 keyword interests for the batch (e.g. ['Banking', 'Insurance']). Precept researches the web to find verified information about each person related to these topics and appends findings as '[<Keyword> Interest]: ...' paragraphs to their professional summary.

leads.description: Array of leads to enrich (up to 1000). Each lead must have either a linkedinUrl OR a combination of firstName + lastName + (companyName or companyDomain).

companyName.description: Name of the company where the contact works.

customData.description: Custom key-value metadata to associate with this lead. Will be returned in results for easy mapping back to your system. Max 5 properties, values max 100 chars.

enrichType.description: Type of contact details to find for this lead. Options: 'emails' (+1 credit), 'phones' (+10 credits). Default: both (+11 credits).

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the contact (e.g. 'https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe'). Highly recommended for most accurate enrichment.

name.description: A readable name for this enrichment job, used for searching on the Precept dashboard.

streamingResults.description: Optional. When true (and webhookUrl is provided), contact results are progressively streamed to the webhook as each lead is enriched. NOT needed when polling with precept_get_job_status.

translate.description: Set to true if lead names are not in English. Names will be translated before enrichment for more accurate results.

webhookUrl.description: Optional webhook URL to receive enrichment results. NOTE: NOT needed for MCP assistant workflows. You can omit this and use precept_get_job_status with the returned enrichment_id to fetch the results directly.

name: precept_enrich_leads

outputSchema.description: Initialization response containing the jobId to poll for results

enrichment_id.description: The unique job ID to poll with precept_get_job_status

finalLimit.description: Adjusted limit based on available credit balance

message.description: Status message describing the initialized job

title: Enrich Leads
